dedupe_keys.name: n p k fertilizer application rates by crop and country for circa 2020 dryad

description: This dataset gives application rates of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium fertiliser, on an elemental basis, for ten major crops in 25 agriculturally important countries, as averages for 2018 to 2022, built from about 800,000 data points spanning 1980 to 2022 through a three-step imputation process. It was produced by Deepak Ray of the University of Minnesota, Tek Sapkota of CIMMYT and Achim Dobermann of the International Fertilizer Association, and published on the Dryad repository on 31 July 2025. Coverage is country level for the 25 countries, with gridded versions at 5 arc-minutes. The files are an Excel workbook of 615 KB with regional and country-by-crop tables and a 9.95 MB archive of 30 NetCDF grids, one per crop and nutrient, free to download under CC0. Caveats: only ten crops and 25 countries are covered, and imputed values carry uncertainty where survey data are sparse. For simulation it provides nutrient demand by crop and country for models of fertiliser supply chains, such as the effect of export restrictions or gas price shocks on crop output, and for climate adaptation and emissions studies. It is related to the NPKGRIDS record in this catalogue, which maps the same nutrients for 173 crops worldwide.
